result.summary: Found 2 layout and styling issues on the screen.

issues.description: Content at the bottom of the scrollable view is obscured by the fixed bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scroll container so the last item is fully visible above the navigation bar.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is abruptly truncated on the card under 'Fastest near you'.
issues.suggestion: Adjust text styling, font size, or card layout to accommodate full restaurant names or use a proper ellipsis with adequate width.
